package.name: amr_safety
package.description: Real-time local execution and safety layer that sits between Nav2's controller_server and the robot: jerk-limited, payload-aware motion smoothing (replaces nav2_velocity_smoother), a traffic-control node that makes AMR-2 yield to AMR-1 on predicted trajectory conflicts, and a speed-dependent safety-distance override that can halt a robot independently of whatever Nav2 is currently commanding.
